instruction: A warehouse starts with 637 boxes. It ships 84 boxes per day for 3 days. It ships some boxes per day for 5 days. How many boxes does it have at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
